findings.description: The scoring pipeline calculates GAD-7 total using only items 1 through 6 (`gad7_1` to `gad7_6`), incorrectly omitting item 7 (`gad7_7`). Consequently, the total, severity band, and prorated status are computed based on a 6-item set instead of the required 7-item set.
findings.evidence: 160 rows affected for `gad7_total`, 40 rows for `gad7_band`, and 21 rows for `gad7_prorated`. For example, respondent R0004 scored 10.0 in the pipeline but 12.0 when scored correctly across all 7 items.
